claim: At its meeting on Thursday 26 November 2026 the Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Board raises the base rate by 25 basis points, from 3.00% to 3.25%.

runs.yes_requires: Within the stated 26 November 2026 window in Asia/Seoul, the Bank of Korea must announce that its Monetary Policy Board raised the Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%. The increase must be stated in the official monetary policy decision on bok.or.kr or reported that day by Yonhap, Reuters, or Bloomberg.
runs.decided_by: The Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Board makes the rate decision. The official Bank of Korea decision or a same-day report from Yonhap, Reuters, or Bloomberg establishes the result.

runs.yes_requires: The Bank of Korea must announce on 26 November 2026 (Asia/Seoul time) that the Monetary Policy Board has raised the Bank of Korea Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%.
runs.decided_by: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy decision on bok.or.kr, or reporting on that day by Yonhap, Reuters, or Bloomberg.

runs.yes_requires: On 26 November 2026 (Asia/Seoul), inside the window 00:00:00–23:59:00 KST, the Bank of Korea announces that the Monetary Policy Board has set the Bank of Korea Base Rate at 3.25%, a 25bp increase from 3.00%, as stated in the BoK monetary policy decision on bok.or.kr or reported that day by Yonhap, Reuters, or Bloomberg.
runs.decided_by: The Bank of Korea monetary policy decision on bok.or.kr, or same-day reporting by Yonhap, Reuters, or Bloomberg.
